name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 6 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.0 days starting 2025-05-23, at wavelengths from 0.89 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
